map.所有人都能吃阿司匹林预防吗？: Can everyone take aspirin for prevention?
map.不是。一级预防（无心血管病）仅对 10 年风险高且出血风险低的部分中老年患者可能: No. Primary prevention (no CVD) may benefit only some middle-aged/elderly with high 10-yr risk and low bleeding risk; >=60 or high bleeding risk generally not recommended. Those with MI/stent (secondary) usually take long-term, per doctor.
map.一级预防常用剂量多少？: What is the usual primary-prevention dose?
map.多为肠溶阿司匹林 75–100 mg/日。剂量过低预防效果不足，过高出血风险上升: Mostly enteric-coated aspirin 75-100 mg/day. Too low is ineffective, too high raises bleeding. Whether and how long to take should be decided by a doctor with risk/bleeding history; do not self-purchase.
map.吃阿司匹林要注意什么？: What to watch when taking aspirin?
map.留意黑便、牙龈出血、瘀斑、胃痛等出血信号；避免与布洛芬等 NSAID 长期同服；: Watch for black stool, gum bleeding, bruises, stomach pain; avoid long-term NSAIDs like ibuprofen; inform doctor before surgery/dental for possible pause. Prior peptic ulcer should eradicate H. pylori and protect stomach.
